quests.title: The Moon Adorning the Night

dialogue.t: Huh, where's Columbina? Paimon doesn't see her anywhere...
Over here.
Whoa! What are you doing all the way up there?
Come join me.
What are we getting ourselves into this time...
Do you remember those stones we went out to gather last time?
Last time? Oh, you mean the ore that glows after absorbing kuuvahki?
Correct. Well, after that, the kuuhenki gathered some more, and I sorted them into two types — darker ones and lighter ones.
Darker ones and lighter ones? But... Why?
To play Moon Chess, of course.
Uh... What's "Moon Chess"?
Oh, you've never played?
I see... Ever since seeing the grids the children of the Frostmoon Scions draw on the ground, I've always wanted to try it out. But I've never had anyone to play it with.
Well, what are the rules?
Hm... It'll be easier if I just show you...
Whoa! Th—That's amazing! How did you do that?
Hm? With a little kuuvahki, of course... You can't do that?
Hahaha... Maybe you should lower your expectations. We're not all moon goddesses...
As you wish. Now, this is the board — it represents the "night sky." And the pieces each player controls represent the "moons."
The two players take turns placing their moons in the sky, and the first to get three moons in a row wins.
Ohhh! So it's basically a version of tic-tac-toe...
So, it's called "Moon Chess" here in Nod-Krai, huh... Talk about giving it a local touch...
I see. Well, in this version, the moons rotate, meaning there can never be more than three moons in the sky at once.
So, when the night sky is full, the moon that rose earliest will vanish.
That... actually makes a lot of sense... and it makes the game a lot harder too!
So, would you like to give it a try? It'll be my first time playing too.

dialogue.sit: (Looks like she's really looking forward to this...)

dialogue.t: Hehe, sounds fun! Paimon will be the referee! {NICKNAME}'s a clever one, though, so watch out!
Alright then.
The three moons...
Perhaps... Like this?
Hmm, let me think...
Oh...
Moons... Moons...
How about here?
Looks like I won this round.
My three moons are connected.
Mm, this should win it.
Mm... The moons wax and wane in an endless cycle...
It seems both sets of moons refuse to be eclipsed.
Are we... heading for a tie?
Ah, you weigh your decisions carefully before making them, I see. Take your time — we have plenty of that, after all.
Did you forget how to place your moons in the night sky? Shall I help you?
You don't like this game? Hm... I find it quite amusing myself.
Mm? Are you staring at me? Your gaze is not subtle.
You're staring... Is the truth of the moons written on my face?
The board's over there, by the way...
Hm, your moons are aligned.
The night sky is yours.
Ah... I must have... slipped up somewhere.

dialogue.sit: You have a wonderful time playing the game with Columbina...

dialogue.t: Thank you, I enjoyed that a lot.
If you'd like... feel free to come keep me company again, sometime.
Here, take this as a token of our promise.

quests.description: The Damselette seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall…
